question: The length of a rectangle increases by 15%. Find the percentage decrease in the breadth in order to maintain the area constantly. (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the value of one quantity increases by R%, to keep the product constant, the percentage reduction in the other quantity is:

⇒ Percentage Decrease = [R ÷ (100 + R)] × 100

⇒ Percentage Decrease = [15 ÷ (100 + 15)] × 100

⇒ Percentage Decrease = (15 ÷ 115) × 100 = 300 ÷ 23

⇒ Percentage Decrease ≈ 13.04%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.04%.**
